title: The Mechanical Voynich: Interactive SVG Concordance Atlas and Iatromathematical Exegesis of Beinecke MS 408
description: Comprehensive 18-monograph codicological decipherment, paleobotanical consensus identification, and iatromathematical analysis of Yale University Beinecke Rare Book & Manuscript Library MS 408 (1404-1438). Authored by Lead Researcher Tammy Lou Casey.
